title: Learning Interaction Pattern Library
principle: Idea bank, not a lesson template. Start from the learning action, then select or invent an interaction.
rules: Do not select a pattern merely because it exists.
Tags describe pedagogical role; they do not prescribe the internal interaction.
A pattern may use an existing component, a generic renderer, a composition of components, or a new component.
Do not repeat the same family in one lesson without pedagogical reason.
'Бързи 5 въпроса' may mix five completely different response mechanics.
Exercise tasks may include agent-generated DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, ZIP, images, datasets or starter files.
Sandbox should permit safe experimentation with visible consequences.
Visualizations may be static, explorable or manipulable; choose the lightest adequate form.
Game framing is optional and must serve a learning action.
